task: Draft a professional follow-up email to a client asking for feedback on last week's product demo.

subAgentMocks.email_drafter:
Subject: Following Up on Last Week's Product Demo

Dear [Client Name],

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to follow up on the product demonstration we held last week and ask if you had any initial thoughts or feedback.

We value your perspective greatly and would love to understand how the demo addressed your needs. If you have any questions or would like to explore specific features further, I am happy to schedule a follow-up call at your convenience.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
